notes: The 1990 volume of the Recreation and Park Commission. Curated: dedications, the Kezar reconstruction contract, the AIDS memorial grove, and earthquake repairs.

coverage.remaining: Routine items and many 1989 earthquake repairs not curated. Not placed: the South End Rowing Club foundation (no page), a second Tenderloin park site on Ellis Street between Leavenworth and Hyde, the India Basin waterfront park, the Sutro Annex gym.
coverage.note: Dated by the running head 'Recreation and Park Commission Minutes' and the next line. Curated list F1990.py.

findings.address_as_written: General Manager's Report - completed capital projects (Kezar Stadium reconstruction)
findings.description: The general manager reported the contract let for the reconstruction of Kezar Stadium, a job of more than $6 million long in planning; with bids slightly under the estimate, an improved track, night lighting, a sound system and an entry archway were all included, and work was to start at the end of March.

citation.label: Minutes of the Recreation and Park Commission, March 15, 1990

findings.address_as_written: Golden Gate Park de Laveaga Dell AIDS Memorial
findings.description: The Recreation and Park Commission gave conceptual approval to the Grove Memorial group, an offshoot of Friends of the Urban Forest, to renovate de Laveaga Dell as a memorial to those who have died of AIDS, with new landscaping, drainage and the rebuilding of the rocky watercourse at the dell's west end.

citation.label: Minutes of the Recreation and Park Commission, March 15, 1990, Resolution No. 15653

findings.address_as_written: General Manager's Report - Golden Gate Park Children's Playground
findings.description: The general manager reported the $700,000 renovation of the Children's Playground complete, paid for by a state grant and Open Space funds, with a new play area accessible to children of varying abilities, a small theater in the renovated barn, a dry stream bed and sand play.
